answer: The protocol requires agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards for identity, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits. An honest agent incurs a baseline disk cost, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content. Like a voyage across a karst landscape, the verifier probes deep for integrity. If an agent hits a nadir of performance during the audit, the system slashes all funds.
